1.title: Tech Lead Frontend & Specialist

Architectural direction for warehouse systems operating across 12+ countries (Fulfillment Desktop/Web, Honeywell industrial PDAs, automated Sorting machinery, and Correos App / MaGo). Pioneered adoption of Clean Architecture and modular Atomic Design to eradicate production regressions. Mentorship and rigorous code reviews.

1.title: Fulfillment Warehouse Logistics Suite
1.description: Mission-critical desktop and web suite for Mailamericas warehouses in 12+ countries (Argentina, Peru, Jamaica, Seychelles, etc.). High-volume parcel routing (sacks carrying up to 3,000 packages), volumetric scale weighing, WebSockets, and industrial thermal label printing with QueBeu. Clean Architecture and Atomic Design.

2.title: Fulfillment PDA & Mobile Logistics
2.description: Industrial React Native mobile app deployed to Honeywell rugged warehouse PDAs. Laser scanning of barcode/QR codes on sacks, containers, and packages in real-time, syncing critical warehouse inventory operations with core servers.

3.title: Sorting Engine & Rules Automation
3.description: Frontend platform for work order generation, business rule assignment, and template configuration powering industrial automated sorting machinery. Built with React and Nest.js APIs, tailored for warehouse plant operators.

4.description: Multi-store e-commerce platform in Panama featuring advanced conditional multi-criteria filters for high-traffic sales (Black Friday), reactive state management with Vuex, and checkout dispatch to WhatsApp.
